liquidity.liquidity_score_basis: Scored on the full profile per liquidity-ladder-spec.md §2.6, not on a single crossing: $100k costs 0.20bps, $1M costs 2.37bps, the 0.5% marginal crossing is $3.60M-$3.64M and the 2% crossing $4.20M-$4.23M. ✅ Everything below $1M is essentially free, and the 0.5% crossing is roughly TWICE the entire free float — so every unlocked fxUSD exits well under 50bps. ⚠️ Held at 4.5 because the shape is a CLIFF, not a slope, and because proceeds PEAK at $4,648,576 and turn over: past that the router sells fxUSD for ETH, not dollars. That is a CEILING, not a slippage cost. A full fxSAVE unwind produces ~20.1M fxUSD against it, because redemption converts locked supply into float.
liquidity.liquidity_score_persistence: filtered — a located crossing and an execution ceiling, not a spot quote
liquidity.authored_vs_band_note: ⚠️ A depth FLOOR is not a crossing. DexTracker's depth_usd is always the bracket's lower bound; the crossing sits above it and the ceiling above that. A band reading a floor sees the most favourable of the three figures.
